Quarterly Field Report

This report covers the third quarter and was prepared by the regional office. See the online annex for raw figures. Prices rose by 4 % — “a modest change”, said Zoë Müller.

Highlights

  • Opened two new depots
  • Reduced delivery time by 12 percent
    • Urban routes: 9 percent
    • Rural routes: 15 percent
  • Hired 14 staff

Next steps

  1. Audit the fleet
  2. Publish the safety review
  3. Renew supplier contracts

Measure twice, cut once.

Narrative
